findings.problem: Explanation for option D (JSON-RPC -32602) claimed protocol errors 'caused the blind retries', but the stem's tool already returned isError:true; the real point is that the MCP spec puts out-of-range/business errors in tool execution errors.
findings.evidence: Tool Execution Errors (isError: true) cover 'Input validation errors (e.g., ... value out of range)' and 'Business logic errors'; 'Clients MAY provide protocol errors to language models'.
findings.fix: Rewrote explanation[3] to state the spec's split between protocol and tool execution errors.
